meta.title: Our programs
meta.description: Clean water, education, healthcare and livelihoods. See how each of our programs works and what it has achieved.

programsHero.titleStart: Four ways we show up for
programsHero.description: Every program starts with a conversation in the village and ends with something the community can run on its own. Explore what we do and the results so far.

image.alt: Volunteers and villagers working together on a community project

programsShowcase.description: Each program is led by local people and measured in public, so you can see exactly what your support makes possible.

programs.title: School for every child
programs.description: We cover books, uniforms, meals and trained teachers so children in rural districts can stay in class and keep learning.
programs.imageAlt: Children reading together in a classroom
highlights: Free books, uniforms and daily meals

programs.title: Clean water for villages
programs.description: Deep-bore hand pumps and filtration units bring safe drinking water within a short walk of home, maintained by trained village committees.
programs.imageAlt: Villagers collecting water from a new hand pump
highlights: Filtration units for schools and clinics
Village repair committees trained and equipped

programs.title: Health camps on wheels
programs.description: Mobile clinics bring check-ups, medicines and nurses to places without a hospital, and train local health workers to follow up.
programs.imageAlt: A nurse examining a patient at a mobile clinic
highlights: Doctor, nurses and a small pharmacy on board

programs.title: Skills for steady incomes
programs.description: Training, tools and small grants help families start or grow a livelihood, so progress continues long after our team has left.
programs.imageAlt: A woman running a small tailoring business

stats.label: Grew their income within a year
